sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: Located in the Vale dos Vinhedos, in Garibaldi, Rio Grande do Sul, Casa Pisçude was born from a rare and peculiar feature of its site: the only plot in the gated community with a natural pond, left by the previous owner. Even before the house existed, the clients transformed the pond into a pool, using it during the summers with family and friends — leading to a playful portmanteau that eventually became the project's official name: it wasn't quite a pool ( piscina in Portuguese), but rather a "Pisçude" (pool-pond). When it came time to design the residence, it made no sense to call it anything else.
